Wow...Amazing. What's this place?\nI think I see something like a castle over there...\nAdventurer, try to ask them.
That castle has been here since a long time ago.\nNow, Celesa, the lord of the castle lives there.
Beautiful...\nIt's really a place I've never seen before...
Wait...what?! Am I hallucinating?!\nThere are two girls in front of us...
You must be daydreaming...
You must be daydreaming...\nWait?! What the, there are really two very\nbeautiful ladies!!
Seems like Sherry and Cersier are now visible to\nLibera and Virgo...
This area is filled with Celesa's power.\nThat's why you can also see us...
Huh...I didn't quite get that.\nShe must be really powerful...
Allow me to introduce myself once again.\nI'm Cersier, the spirit of the night sakura tree.
And I'm Sherry, the spirit of the daytime sakura\ntree. I think you already know that we're sisters.
A-ah, yeah... N-nice to m-meet you!
Nice to meet you.\nBy the way, can we go to the castle over there?
Yes. We owe you guys big time and Celesa wants to\nsee you too. This way, please...
BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Mimesia!!
W-what the?!
No way...the monsters are even in Celesa's\nterritory...
My goodness...!! I wonder if Celesa is okay?!
Hey wait! It's dangerous for you to go.\nLeave it to us!
But...
Do you know how it looks like inside the castle?
Y-yes...
In that case, please lead the way.\nBecause we'll get lost and just waste time\nif it's only us.
Dear adventurer! You came here for us again?
I just told Libera and the others that I wish\nyou were here!
Oh, you came at the right time.\nTroublesome thing happened again, so we want you\nto help.
Actually, the monster you defeated last time\nreappeared and Celesa is being held hostage in\nSakura Castle. We should do something...
You're gonna fight with us, right?
You're gonna fight with us, right?\n...Okay, awesome!
Sherry, Cersier, the adventurer is coming with us!
Thank you! Please save Celesa!
We'll go to the castle with you too.\nLet's get going!
Oh, what's this?!\nWhat's going on?!
We don't know either!\nThey suddenly appeared as if they'd fallen out of\nthe sky...Whoa?! Ugh...
So where's Celesa? And where are Sherry and\nCersier?!
Lady Celesa and the guests from another world took\nrefuge on the top floor!

So many monsters are loitering around, this is\ntroublesome.
They somewhat seem more murderous than those\noutside. We should be careful when fighting them...
Anyway, we'd better hide from them and proceed\nslowly...
I wonder if it's gonna be safer and faster if we\nsplit into two teams...
I wonder if it's gonna be faster if we split into\ntwo teams.
I think it's a good idea since we've got 2 guides.\nIn that case, adventurer, you go with Sherry, and\nCersier is coming with us.
Oh, I think I'll be fine alone.\nWhy don't you go with the adventurer?
Perhaps you will be fine alone, but will you be\nable to take care of Cersier too?
Of course I can!\nBut maybe she'll be safer if you're with us too.
Do you think you'll be okay alone, adventurer?
Okay, great. Whoever finds Celesa first, send a\nsignal. If you see the signal, join the person\nwho sends it...okay?
Look for the door key while hiding from the guards\nand head for the top of the castle!!
The search gauge will go up gradually when a\nsearch point is selected and the search is\ncompleted once it reaches its maximum.
The gauge rises faster if you tap [Search quickly],\nbut you could get caught more easily.
If the guards find you, all the items obtained\nfrom the search will be lost and Sherry will be\ndetained.
If Sherry gets caught, find Prison Key and rescue\nher.
C-Celesa...!
Who the heck are you?!\nHow dare you enter my castle without permission!\nUnforgivable!!
Celesa! It's me, Sherry!! Don't you remember?\nPlease, wake up!!
W-wait! Are you really gonna kill me?\nThe core of my body is the lord of this castle,\na fairy, you know!!
Noooo, C-Celesaaa!!
Relax. That wasn't the real Celesa.\nIt was the crystal monster that claimed to be\nCelesa, just an impostor...
Whaaat?! So, where's the real Celesa?!
She was held captive somewhere else...\nSee!
Celesa!! I'm glad you're okay!!
Sherry, I'm sorry for making you worried...
Are they the people you were talking about...
Yes! The adventurers who saved me and sis from the\neerie crystal monster!!
Not only Sherry and her sister, but you also saved\nthis castle from the hijacker.\nHow could I thank you...Thank you very much.
Actually, we only found out that the castle was in\ndanger because Sherry and Cersier brought us here.\nYou should thank them instead.
As we always enjoy your beautiful sakura, we must\nhelp at times like this. Or the leader who couldn't\ncome due to his lower back pain will reprimand us.
They came to see the sakura, but we troubled them\ninstead. We must entertain them with our utmost\nhospitality. Get ready, girls.
Okay!!
All right! Let's enjoy it to the fullest for Tenert\nwho couldn't come before we go home!!
Hihihi...Tenert will be so pissed if he knows about\nthis later. You'll join us too, right?
You should...!
Adventurer, thank you. Thanks to you, the day\nregion of the sakura world remains peaceful. I'll\ngive it to them too later, so please take this...
Hey, adventurer! What are you doing?!\nCome and help! He who doesn't help, neither shall\nhe enjoy, you know!!
C-Celesa...!
It's gonna be different this time.\nGet outta the castle now if her life is precious\nto you!!
Celesa, please hold on a little longer!
Really? You little rascal!\nYou think we'll just listen to you?!
Yeahhh!

Hey! You came at the right time!\nWe just got rid of all the monsters coming up!
Phew! They just kept coming nonstop.\nThey made me spend my energy a lot...
..Hm? Libera? She's got an urgent errand to run,\nso she couldn't come this time.\nShe really wanted to come though.
Tenert, Virgo, I'm sorry for the trouble.\nAdventurers, I'm glad that you're here now.
I thought we could enjoy hanami outside as soon as\neveryone arrived, but suddenly there were tons of\nmonsters inside and outside the castle...
Celesa?!
Whoa! A-are you okay?!
I thought I saw something black...What was it?
It must mean that Celesa's tree is in danger...
Celesa's tree???
Yes, every sakura spirit was born from a sakura\ntree. We live with our own tree. However, if the\ntree withers, we'll disappear...

Something unusual must have happened to
Celesa's\ntree, that's why her health suddenly took a turn\nfor the worse...
Celesa's tree is the centerpiece of the Garden of\nDay Sakura. If by any chance the tree withers,\nit could mean the end of the garden...
What the...
Doesn't that mean the Garden of Day Sakura is at\nstake?!
In order to protect the garden, I'd like to\nrequest your help to remove the imminent threat to\nCelesa's tree!
Would you please help us?!
Agree to help
Decline
Don't worry, we've decided to protect the\nwonderful Sakura here!
We'll definitely get rid of any misfortune that\nbefalls Celesa!
A little reward would be nice if possible.\nThanks in advance!
Hey, you must be joking right?!\nWe have a situation here!
That's not like you.\nShouldn't we help those in trouble even if we have\nto risk our lives?
Hey, I'm sure we'll get many rewards if we help\nCelesa! So just quit your bellyaching and\nlet's go!!
Ohh, you came again!!
I was just talking about you with Tenert and the\nothers...!
Um, I can somehow tell what's going on...
Yo, you guys came at the right time!\nYou're right, a terrible thing is happening again.\nWe need your help.
Actually, the monster we beat last time at the\nsakura garden seems to be doing something bad\nagain to Celesa's tree. We must do something...!
You'll fight with us, right...? Alright, it's\nsettled then! Sherry, Cersier, don't worry!\nThe adventurer has agreed to help!!
Thank you! Please help Celesa!
We'll go with you to Celesa's tree garden.\nWe'd better get going now!
